settings.question: Is my photo good enough to use?
settings.answer:
You'll need to take a high-quality headshot of your pup in order to ensure our artists can create the best quality artwork.

Please follow these guidelines:

  • Take the photo in good lighting - outdoor during daylight is typically best.
  • Try to take the photo at eye level with your pet
  • They don't need to be looking at the camera, but their face should be in focus. 
  • Get close up - this way we can see your pet's unique features
  • Ensure the photo is not blurry
  • Keep all facial features fully in frame (e.g. ears!)

Ensure that the photo is an accurate representation of your pups actual colors (poor lighting can cause improper coloring). Our artists will use the colors in the photo as a base palette to work from.

Once we receive your photo, our team will let you know if there's an issue with your photo via email. If we do require a new photo from you, this may lengthen your delivery time by a few days. Following our photo guidelines is the best way to receive your artwork as quick as possible!

Please note: If you decline to provide a new photo after we have informed you that the original photo may not result in the best quality artwork, then we cannot refund you. It's your responsibility to ensure that you are happy with the photo you provide.

settings.question: Can I print multiple dogs on one canvas?
settings.answer: We currently only accept orders for one pup per portrait, as our artists work diligently to ensure that each portrait is personal to every dog.

settings.question: How is the artwork made?
settings.answer: We work with a small team of in-house artists that create digital art using a variety of mediums and techniques to create something that is personal and unique to your dog. An artist will be assigned your order depending on the style chosen to best suit your pup's needs.

settings.question: I want to add or remove something from my photo, can you do that?
settings.answer:
During the time of your order, we can absolutely work with you to add or remove certain elements if it is within the chosen style and within reason. However, once we've sent the preview of your artwork for approval, we cannot accept any major changes to the piece (this phase is for fine tuning) - so please leave a note with your order, and our artists will use their discretion on whether it is possible. 

Please be advised that we will be unable to accept any requests for mature, NSFW, or controversial content. We appreciate your understanding.

settings.question: What if I don't like the final product?
settings.answer:
We are committed to making sure you adore your artwork - and we wouldn't want any less for your pup.

Once your portrait is prepared, we will promptly notify you through email. You'll have 48 hours to let us know of any fine-tuning necessary, or give your approval to print. If we have not received any response from you during the 48 hour period, we will assume your approval and proceed with the printing process.
